name: Chunked Volume Rendering with Occupancy Grid Estimator
aliases: Chunked volume rendering with occupancy grid estimator
definition: A chunked rendering loop that uses an OccGridEstimator to sample along rays, queries a radiance field for density and color at sample midpoints, and composites the result per chunk.
summary: Chunked Volume Rendering with Occupancy Grid Estimator accelerates rendering by combining chunked ray batching with a hierarchical occupancy grid for adaptive sampling.
